submission.justification: Mixture-G2 is the only candidate highly likely to comply with the hard requirement that GWP100 ≤ 150, as per the environmental policy. Although its time resolution is not as good as the standard fluorinated mixture (Mixture-G3), that option is disqualified due to its expected high GWP. Simulation gives a time resolution of 2.0 ns at 2 mm gap, which is the best achievable performance with Mixture-G2 within the constraints. All other requirements are also met.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is listed as a candidate in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: The GWP100 of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is described as based on newer replacement gases, i.e., low-GWP formulations; standard and partially substituted fluorinated mixtures are known to exceed 150.
Selected gap is 2.0 mm, within range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: For the compliant mixture (Mixture-G2), simulation at 2 mm gap produces the best time resolution (2.0 ns).
